levels.surface: علي بن محمد الرازي المعروف بعلان الكليني

notes: The signed letter (توقيع) from the Qaim is reported with no Imam named in the text: the author of a rescript is not written, so needs_ruling (rule 11).
«إبراهيم وَ مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنَيِ الْفَرَجِ» are two co-transmitters at one level (rule 2).
«8-» and «رضي الله عنه» are left out; the last link is Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, the transmitter of the story (rule 6).
